source: CGZ arXiv:1712.04887v3 eqn (20), Lemma 2.4(a),(d),(e); Addenda 27-30 (this repo)
scope: scope-(a) BRACKETING, not a value. Computing CGZ's class in F^x/(F^x)^m (read on the Teichmuller part) gives 0 for xi, and 0 for all NINE root choices -- Lemma 2.4(a) confirmed by measurement. But the class is identically 0 on ALL 23 admissible base arguments, while being nonzero on an element off the base, so the invariant carries no information about xi in F and the 0 is vacuous. Bracket: B = Q_25 is too small (root-independence fails) and F = Q_5(mu_1872) too large (the class collapses). Reading CGZ, the invariant is likely not this bare class at all -- their Lemma 2.4(d),(e) keep Galois structure that a quotient of units discards. No eps_m value is claimed at m >= 3; the m = 2 result of PR #4968 is untouched.
